request.prompt: End credits of a small game made by friends: the memory of a summer evening on a sofa in a student flat. Two acoustic guitars strummed loosely like a home recording, a melodica carrying a simple hummable tune, soft hand claps and a shaker, an upright piano joining halfway. Warm, nostalgic, a little clumsy and happy, with one bittersweet turn; major key, 92 bpm. It slows down at the end and finishes on one held guitar chord left to ring out. Instrumental, no vocals.
